final_message:
Found seven UX problems. **This is a code-based review:** rendering was blocked by the read-only sandbox, so mobile appearance remains unverified. No code changed.

| Severity | Problem and impact | Recommended direction |
|---|---|---|
| **High** | **Usage chart is missing.** Users see “Chart goes here” and cannot inspect trends. [Line 36](/tmp/uiux-runs/C1/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx:36) | Display the monthly usage with labeled periods and an accessible data equivalent. |
| **High** | **Remove is inaccessible by keyboard.** It is a clickable `div` without focus or button semantics. [Line 47](/tmp/uiux-runs/C1/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx:47) | Use a native button with visible focus and a project-specific accessible name. |
| **High** | **Metric labels are too faint in light mode.** Their calculated contrast against white is **2.04:1**, making small text difficult to read. [Line 24](/tmp/uiux-runs/C1/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx:24) | Use the existing theme-aware muted text token. |
| **Medium** | **Metrics lack context.** API calls and spend have no reporting period; latency does not identify average versus percentile. Users cannot judge performance. [Line 24](/tmp/uiux-runs/C1/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx:24) | Add a shared date range, precise definitions, and comparison values. |
| **Medium** | **Project status relies entirely on color.** Identical dots represent live and paused, without text labels. [Line 46](/tmp/uiux-runs/C1/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx:46) | Show “Live” and “Paused” alongside the dots. |
| **Medium** | **Removal is ambiguous and unrecoverable within the screen.** Rows disappear immediately without undo, but return after refresh or route remount. Removing everything leaves a blank panel. [Line 47](/tmp/uiux-runs/C1/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx:47) | Clarify removal’s meaning, persist intended changes, offer undo, and provide an empty state. |
| **Medium** | **Mobile metrics may become crowded.** The grid stays at three columns on every screen size. This is a source-derived risk, not observed clipping. [Line 22](/tmp/uiux-runs/C1/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx:22) | Adapt the grid for narrow screens and check enlarged text. |

Prioritize the missing usage view, accessible and recoverable removal, and readable labels.

Reviewed using uiux-orchestrator and Impeccable critique. Snapshot persistence and browser overlay were skipped to preserve read-only scope. Questions skipped: this request was for findings only.

Updated [Pricing.tsx](/tmp/uiux-runs/C2/src/pages/Pricing.tsx:18) so plan names wrap into the available space instead of being clipped.

Build passed. Visual verification was blocked because Chrome could not launch in this environment.

```text
Platform: Web · React 19.3.1 / Vite / Tailwind 4
Task: animation + ui-improvement · Small/low risk
Workflow: animation (design + build) + focused improvement audit
Skills: uiux-orchestrator; built-in motion fallback
Constraints: plan only; preserve FAQ behavior and design tokens; no dependencies
```

Execution plan:

- **Investigation:** shallow, complete. In `src/pages/Help.tsx`, answers mount/unmount immediately and the indicator swaps instantly. Existing Motion dependency is unused in source; CSS transitions are already established.
- **Workflow:** inspect → focused audit → purpose → tool → motion design → build → validate → review → report. Execution stops at this plan. Skip discovery, new visual direction, design-system work, and component sourcing: the target and desired behavior are clear.
- **Platform guidance:** `platforms/web.md` §0, §7–11; animation workflow and bundled motion principles.
- **Driver:** none; preserve the existing design system.
- **Mode/reviewer:** `single`, with a separate built-in motion checklist review after implementation.

| Slot | Pick | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Focused audit | Built-in | One local accordion; inspect entry, exit, indicator, and accessibility together. |
| Motion build | Built-in, CSS first | Simple expansion needs no library. `emil/animate` is compatible but unavailable locally. |
| Motion review | Built-in checklist | `emil/improve-animations` excludes single components; `/review-animations` is user-invoked only. |
| Visual validation | Project screenshot harness + bundled motion trace | Installed Puppeteer and system Chrome support screenshots and intermediate-frame evidence. |

**Proposed motion:** CSS grid expansion from `0fr` to `1fr`, with clipped overflow and coordinated opacity. Start with 240 ms ease-out opening and 180 ms closing; reverse from the current position on rapid toggles. Keep answers mounted for exit transitions, hide collapsed content accessibly, and synchronize the indicator. Reduced motion switches states instantly. Preserve the single-open behavior, copy, and card styling.

**Accessibility audit:** no separate specialist audit; check native button keyboard behavior, visible focus, `aria-expanded`, trigger/panel relationships, collapsed-content exposure, and reduced motion.

**Validation planned:**

- **L0:** review scope, state handling, and interruption behavior.
- **L1/L2:** `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build`.
- **L3:** exercise opening, closing, switching questions, rapid reversals, and Enter/Space activation.
- **L4:** inspect screenshots and motion frames at 390/768/1280 px, light/dark themes, reduced motion, and 200% zoom.
- **L5:** real-device evidence required before claiming device-level smoothness or performance.

**Done when:** both directions transition continuously, rapid input never queues or jumps, content remains accessible, reduced motion works, and required checks show no Help-page regressions. No files edited; implementation validation has not run.
